# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good faith, and keep discussion focused on the
work. Harassment, personal attacks, and demeaning comments are not welcome.

Contributions are additionally bound by the
[GitHub Community Guidelines](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/github-terms/github-community-guidelines)
and the [GitHub Acceptable Use Policies](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/acceptable-use-policies/github-acceptable-use-policies).

## Reporting

Report conduct issues privately to the maintainer via
[GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/Ranzlappen/Minecraft-java-mods/security/advisories/new)
or by direct message. Reports are handled confidentially.
